answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with zero-knowledge uniqueness proofs: before joining, each agent proves in zero knowledge that its underlying credential has not already minted another identity, without revealing the credential itself. Like water filtering through karst, only one clean channel emerges per source; a grove of fake accounts collapses because every duplicate proof is rejected, and the ledger records just an onyx-black commitment that is verifiable, unlinkable, and impossible to clone at scale.
